findings.issue: A clean checkout silently skips 11 build-dependent acceptance tests, including backup/restore and HTTP console authorization, while npm test succeeds. Prepare the current runtime before test collection and fail the suite if compilation fails.

The new timeout fixture only stalls before response headers. A timeout while reading a response body is incorrectly classified as invalid-response in attemptOnce, so the allowed fallback never runs. The 60ms real-HTTP budget also risks timing out a healthy fallback on a busy host.

The acceptance table claims quarantine survives success races, but its referenced test is sequential. An already-dispatched successful call deletes a concurrent quarantine via clearBreaker, and a transient failure overwrites it via openBreaker, allowing future dispatch to an isolated candidate.

The HALF_OPEN failure test assumes its final call happens inside a 150ms cooldown. If the fallback response or scheduling takes longer, correct code legally probes A again and fails the assertion. Advance only the policy clock to establish cooldown boundaries deterministically.

needs-human: Timeout cost coverage only asserts an unknown receipt without maxCostUsd. The existing route checks costs per successful response, does not reserve a worst-case logical-call budget before dispatch, and can fall back after an unknown-cost timeout. Closing the issue's hard-cap acceptance requires an approved pricing/reservation contract; this review will not invent new budget configuration or provider guarantees.

Repair fixtures mock model execution but leave nativeAdmission live, so npm test reads the operator account through a real Codex app-server and changes its outcome with local quota. The original reviewed head reproduces the failures. Isolate account admission using the existing test-double pattern and assert that repair fixtures never invoke metadata RPC; retain the production quota gate and every original assertion.

summary: Fixed five actionable defects: skipped clean-checkout acceptance, response-body timeout fallback, quarantine overwrite races, cooldown timing, and repair-fixture account leakage; each has red-to-green regression evidence. needs-human: issue #51 logical-call hard-cap acceptance remains incomplete until pre-dispatch pricing and reservation semantics are approved. On Windows, typecheck/build, all 2025 Vitest tests and 17 Node regression tests passed with exit 0; details are in .issue-loop-evidence.json.
